summary: This source computes n=floor(dim²/sparsity) and terminal CSR offset n. Its one-thread-per-row kernel bounds global row by dim and traverses rowStart through rowEnd, accumulating val[j]*vec[cols[j]] before storing. Main warms once, records the start event, invokes the kernel iterations times, records/synchronizes stop, then copies output. The compiled timed loop calls the launch-bearing spmvGpu routine and stub, both traced through cudaLaunchKernel; the native sm86 kernel was inspected through its CSR loop and store.
